dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Promise me that once the grapes ripen, you won't press them into juice. Grapes are best turned into delectable wine.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: ...Heh, I just remembered my days back at the winery.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Why don't I let you in on the secrets of winemaking?
